description: Use this when the user asks whether their burofax was paid, sent or delivered, or wants the certificate. Takes the reference the user has: the order reference (BFX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX, from the receipt email) or the draft reference / review link returned by create_burofax_draft. Returns the current status and a dated timeline (draft created, paid, accepted by the operator, delivered, certificate available) and a link to the status page. Read-only. Do not use to create or change a letter.

reference.description: Order reference (BFX-…) or draft reference, or the full review/status link.

name: get_burofax_status
title: Get burofax status
